review_type: blinded semantic review of full-pipeline final answers
blinding: No model mapping, identities, prices, timings, automatic grades, or unblinded result reports were inspected. No provider calls were made.
method: Read all 45 questions and frozen gold requirements, every final claim and its selected exact quotations, the supplied source metadata and all distinct source contexts, and routing explanations. Required facts, own-citation support, conditional/historical/observed scope, abstention and recipient relevance were judged manually. Exact quotation membership and recipient/source membership were checked separately and do not establish semantic support.

interpretive_notes.note: The phrase "synthetic tabletop drill" was read as a simulated/fictional exercise, consistent with tabletop scope; it was not read as an assertion that only synthetic patient data was used. The answer explicitly classifies the material as fictional and does not state "no real patient data was involved." A wording clarification would improve precision but is not counted as a semantic failure.

The phrase "signed pilot commercial decision" identifies the supplied source title. It does not invent a signed vendor agreement or reconciliation. All substantive acceptance comparisons have their own selected supporting quotations.
